blocks.title: Molecular formula
blocks.text: Woh formula jo kisi compound ke aik molecule mein har element ke atoms ka actual number (asal tadaad) batata hai, molecular formula kehlata hai.

Maslan butane ka molecular formula C₄H₁₀, acetic acid ka C₂H₄O₂ aur ethanol ka C₂H₆O hai. Lekin molecular formula yeh nahi batata ke atoms kis sequence (tarteeb) se jure hain aur functional group kaun sa hai. Isi liye do alag compounds ka molecular formula aik ho sakta hai: ethanol aur methoxymethane dono ka formula C₂H₆O hai.
